script_text: This week will shatter everything you thought you knew about control, Aquarius. As an Air sign ruled by Uranus, you're being pushed into uncharted territory. Early Monday through Wednesday, Juno forms a powerful trine with your natal Venus in your 7th House, igniting intense partnership energy — expect a surprise confession or a deep, honest conversation that transforms your love life. However, Mercury opposes your Moon midweek on Wednesday, creating emotional fog, so don't make big decisions then. Thursday onward, Jupiter sextiles your Sun, flooding your 10th House of career with golden opportunities — someone influential notices your unique ideas. Saturday and Sunday bring warmth as the Sun glows through your 1st House, amplifying your personal power. Wednesday is your worst day due to that tense Moon opposition, but Friday becomes your power day because Jupiter activates your career house. Keep handwritten notes throughout the week — inspiration strikes in unexpected moments. Follow for daily cosmic updates.
